title: Iran's Army Strikes US Military Targets in Jordan in 9th Phase of "Thunder" Operation
text:
Iran's Army Strikes US Military Targets in Jordan in 9th Phase of "Thunder" Operation"

"The Islamic Republic of Iran's Army, hours ago in the ninth phase of Operation Sa'eqeh (Thunder), targeted communication systems and fuel depots belonging to the US military in Jordan using destructive drones. This operation was carried out in response to hostile acts by the enemy."

"The drone strikes specifically hit a fixed radar site, communication systems, and fuel storage facilities at the Al-Azraq base in Jordan, which is used by US forces. The attack comes as retaliation for earlier enemy aggression that targeted areas inside Iran, including the Bampur garrison in Iranshahr, which resulted in the martyrdom of seven non-commissioned officers and soldiers from the Iranian Army's Ground Forces."

"The Al-Azraq base is described as a key strategic and command center for US forces in West Asia, housing anti-missile defense systems."

"The Iranian Army strongly condemned what it called the enemy's brutal attacks on the residential quarters of both conscript and permanent personnel in Iranshahr, characterizing these actions as stemming from the enemy's inhumane nature. The Army emphasized that such crimes will never fade from history, stating: "The sons of this nation in the Army are devoted to the people and defenders of Iran's security. They will not waver one bit in their honorable duty to defend the nation and the Islamic homeland, and to avenge the blood of our dear martyrs.
